notes.contact_flag: The contact flag is not shared: A's 'gripper' sensor is one finger, B's flag is either of two tip pads. Within-robot comparisons are unaffected; A-vs-B stage rates carry a B-lenient bias.
notes.target_limits: A has no target-limit check, so the same out-of-limit target ends a B episode but not an A episode. Within-robot ΔB is unaffected.
notes.safety_abort: scored from the files on disk; a :298 abort leaves one more gate row than tracking rows, and that row (the aborted control) is dropped; under 3 scored rows it is a fail with no stage (empty_trace)
notes.times: control/15 s on both robots; B simulation_s = (control+1)/15 is not used
notes.M2: descriptive only, among winners, no test
notes.headline: score()['pass']; stages win only cross-checked
